understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by entering each goal cell while the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal’s requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and can be blocked by walls. Modifier tiles change the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle shape, color modifiers cycle color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. Goal status reports which attribute is mismatched and may identify modifier locations. Each move consumes stamina, including blocked moves; when stamina reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
